literal_meaning: গাধা ও ঘোড়ার সংকর জাতীয় পশু (mule, hybrid offspring of donkey and horse)
figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, an illegitimate child; a specific insult
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা খচ্চর, কারো সন্তান নয়!
example_sentences_in_english: He's a real bastard, no one's child!
Don't trust that mule of a guy.
note: This idiom draws from the biological fact that mules are sterile hybrids, symbolizing illegitimacy in Bengali slang.
